en.title: Drug test results revealed for Hasan Şaş and Yağız Sabuncuoğlu
en.summary: Former footballer Hasan Şaş tested positive for cocaine and codeine in a drug operation, while journalist Yağız Sabuncuoğlu's test came back negative.

stories.title: Erasmus için Portekiz’e gitmişti: 23 yaşındaki Melek, nehirde boğularak hayatını kaybetti

en.title: 23-year-old Melek who went to Portugal for Erasmus drowned in river
en.summary: A 23-year-old student on an Erasmus exchange in Portugal drowned in a river while swimming with friends. Her body was to be returned to her hometown in Aydın for burial.

en.title: Fire at chemical product factory in Mersin!
en.summary: A cleaning products manufacturing facility in the Akdeniz district of Mersin caught fire in the morning hours for an undetermined reason.

stories.title: Ezgi Apartmanı davasında yeni gelişme: Başsavcılık, 3 sanığın 'olası kast'tan cezalandırılması için İstinaf'a başvurdu

en.title: New development in Ezgi Apartment case: Chief Prosecutor appeals to appellate court for 3 defendants to be sentenced for 'probable intent'
en.summary: The chief prosecutor's office is seeking to have three defendants in the Ezgi Apartment case, which resulted in 35 deaths during the February 6 earthquakes, sentenced under the charge of probable intent. The defendants include two pastry shop owners and an architect.

en.title: Alarming fire at chemical factory in Mersin
en.summary: A fire broke out at a chemical factory in the Akdeniz district of Mersin and firefighting efforts are underway to extinguish it.

en.summary: Test results have been released in a drug investigation by the Bakırköy Chief Prosecutor's Office involving the two public figures.

en.title: Former SPK president to give statement today
en.summary: Ibrahim Ömer Gönül, former president of the Capital Markets Board, will give a statement today as a suspect in a fund investigation.

en.title: New development in 'fund' fraud case: Former SPK Chair summoned for questioning
en.summary: The former head of Turkey's Capital Markets Board, İbrahim Ömer Gönül, has been called to give a statement as a suspect in an investigation into a fund fraud case.

en.title: BREAKING | New development in fund investigation! Former SPK Chair İbrahim Ömer Gönül to give statement
en.summary: A notable development has occurred in the fund investigation being conducted by Istanbul's Chief Prosecutor's Office, involving the former head of the Capital Markets Board from 2022-2026.

en.title: Fraud operation in 10 provinces: 13 detained
en.summary: A fraud operation conducted across 10 provinces centered in Mardin resulted in the detention of 13 suspects involved in internet-related crimes.

en.title: BREAKING! Famous footballer Hasan Şaş's test result revealed! Flash development in drug investigation!
en.summary: Tests conducted in a drug investigation involving celebrities found cocaine in the blood and urine of former footballer and sports commentator Hasan Şaş, along with codeine and cocaine in hair samples.

stories.title: İngiltere’nin büyümesi yeniden hesaplandı: Asıl sürpriz yatırımlarda çıktı

en.title: Britain's growth recalculated: The real surprise came in investments
en.summary: The United Kingdom's second quarter economic growth was revised upward from 0.4% to 0.5%. Business investment annual growth was significantly raised from 0.8% to 5.2%.

stories.title: Bir depo benzin için ülke değiştiriyorlar: Yeni zam kapıda

en.title: Crossing borders for a tank of fuel: New price hike on the horizon
en.summary: Rising fuel prices in Greece are driving drivers across the border to Bulgaria to fill their tanks more cheaply. A price gap of up to 56 cents per liter for petrol exists between the two countries, with further increases expected in Greece.

stories.title: Brezilya kotayı tüketti: Çin yarın yüzde 55 vergiyi başlatıyor

en.title: Brazil exhausted its quota: China launches 55% tariff tomorrow
en.summary: China's 2026 quota for beef imports from Brazil has been completely filled. Starting October 1, Beijing will impose an additional 55% customs tariff on imports exceeding the quota.

stories.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Yılmaz: 2029’a kadar 2,1 milyon ilave istihdam öngörüyoruz

en.title: Vice President Yılmaz: We project 2.1 million additional jobs by 2029
en.summary: Turkey's Vice President announced plans to create 2.1 million additional jobs through 2029 by increasing investment capacity, strengthening vocational education, supporting workforce participation, and bringing idle labor into production.

stories.title: İlk Evim Konut Kredisi kampanyası başladı mı, ne zaman başlıyor? Yüzde 1,20 konut kredisi ne zaman verilecek?

en.title: Has the First Home Housing Loan campaign started, when will it begin? When will the 1.20 percent housing loan be provided?
en.summary: Prospective homebuyers are closely monitoring the First Home Housing Loan campaign for its launch date and the timing of 1.20 percent interest rate loans. Updates on the campaign are being closely tracked.
